name: deep-review
description: Repository-wide detective review with evidence-backed 1–5 readiness scoring.

interface.shortDescription: Trace a change deeply and score its readiness.
interface.longDescription: Investigates a bounded change beyond its diff, follows its blast radius through the repository, challenges candidate findings, and can make an authorized repair and rescore.
defaultPrompt: Review this branch deeply and score it out of 5.
Fix supported findings, then rescore once; it was authored by Claude.
Challenge these review findings before I fix them.
